envelope.description: Verify compiled integration and one useful live design review

body.title: Verify compiled integration and one useful live design review
body.summary: Add reproducible compiled transport smoke and focused route/coverage regressions, then run one meaningful independent hosted review through the normal MCP interface. Record complete evidence, limitations and documentation; distinguish deterministic fake-provider tests from hosted review.
acceptanceChecks: Production build and compiled normal MCP/daemon smoke pass with clearly labeled fake CLI output; code-review focused regressions remain healthy.
Epic, Standalone and Issue fixture matrix proves different required artifacts and negative branch-confusion behavior.
One real independent review through normal insrc_review_step reads linked current design/code, emits coherent chunks and finishes with retrievable feedback; no raw internal RPC substitute.

Record review-id/attempt, model identity, timing, plan/chunk outcomes, test execution results and limits. A blocked live run is reported as outstanding, not counted as passing or replaced with author self-review.
No unrelated full test sweep, sibling-story implementation or new activation/qualification system is added; normal deployment/restart if needed is documented as execution prerequisite.

Record acknowledgement latency, per-chunk timing and when completed feedback became visible. A useful completed execution may report design findings or explicit substantive verification limits; do not rerun hosted reviews merely to obtain a clean design verdict. Technical failure or no substantive inspection remains outstanding.

tests.name: Production build and compiled MCP/daemon fake-CLI smoke complete planning, chunks, incremental feedback and report retrieval.
Focused existing task-review schema/routing/owner regressions pass without hosted reruns or unrelated full sweep.
One meaningful independent design review via normal insrc_review_step records model, acknowledgement/chunk timing, scope, actual feedback and limits separately from fake fixtures.
